definition: An occupation is the work that a person does to earn a living. This can describe both long-term careers or more temporary employment. Occupation can also refer to the state of living or residing on a piece of property. The term is commonly used in this context regarding statutes on adverse possession, which require continuous occupation of property for a specified duration. Occupation can also describe the status of one nation with a military presence in another nation for an extended period. This generally occurs during or following an armed conflict or war. occupancy / occupation Dictionary compilation | 26 September 2026
